test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: CRY is an organisation that works for the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**protection of child rights**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CRY (Child Rights and You)** is an Indian non-governmental organization that works towards ensuring the rights of children.
 
• CRY focuses on a variety of issues such as child labor, malnutrition, education, and child abuse.
 
• The organization works through various grassroots initiatives and advocacy efforts to create a secure and healthy environment for children.
 
• CRY collaborates with local communities, government agencies, and other stakeholders to promote child rights and welfare.
 
• The mission of CRY is to enable people to take responsibility for the situation of underprivileged children and motivate them to seek resolution through individual and collective action.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• CRY was founded in 1979 by Rippan Kapur.
 
• The organization has impacted the lives of over 3 million children across 19 states in India.
 
• CRY works on the principle that child rights are integral to human rights and focuses on ensuring that every child has access to education, healthcare, and protection from exploitation.
 
• CRY’s approach involves addressing the root causes of deprivation and inequality that affect children.
